# CARZev: Electric Vehicles in India Database

CARZev is India's most comprehensive database for Electric Vehicles (EVs). It provides price checks, real-world range calculations, side-by-side spec comparisons, state-specific FAME subsidy estimations, and EMI/savings calculators for electric cars, scooters, and bikes.

## Key Web Pages & URLs
- Home Page (`/`): Dashboard overview, popular electric vehicles, search bar, and top brands.
- Catalogue listings (`/?page=listings`): Filterable index of electric cars, two-wheelers, and commercial vehicles. Supports filtering by brand, budget (under 5 Lakh, under 10 Lakh, etc.), and launches.
- Comparison Tool (`/?page=compare`): Side-by-side telemetry comparison of up to 3 EVs.
- Savings Calculator (`/?page=savings-calc`): Tool to calculate fuel/maintenance cost savings compared to ICE petrol/diesel vehicles.
- EMI Calculator (`/?page=emi-calc`): Financial estimator for EV loans.
- Expert Consultation (`/?page=consultation`): Booking portal for local FAME subsidies and road tax advice.
- Blog (`/?page=blog`): EV news, subsidy guides, and reviews.

## EV Database Coverage
CARZev contains key specifications, pros, cons, and FAME-II subsidy parameters for:
- Tata Motors (Tiago EV, Tigor EV, Punch EV, Nexon EV, Curvv EV, Harrier EV)
- Mahindra (XUV 3XO EV, BE 6e, XEV 9e, XEV 9S)
- MG Motor (Comet EV, Windsor EV, MG ZS EV, M9 EV, MG Cyberster)
- BYD (Atto 3, Seal, Sealion 7, e6)
- Hyundai (Kona Electric, Ioniq 5, Creta Electric)
- Maruti Suzuki (e Vitara)
- Toyota (Urban Cruiser Ebella)
- Kia (Carens EV, EV6, EV9)
- Citroen (eC3)
- VinFast (VF6, VF7, VFe34)
